card.line: Hachilah is a hill in Judah near Ziph, south of Jeshimon, where David hid from King Saul and chose to spare Saul's life.

moments.title: The Ziphites tell Saul
moments.text: The Ziphites went to Saul at Gibeah and said David was hiding on the hill of Hachilah. Saul thanked them and told them to find out all of David's hiding places.

moments.title: Saul camps on the hill
moments.text: The Ziphites told Saul again where David was. Saul took three thousand chosen men and camped beside the road at Hachilah. David was in the wilderness and learned that Saul had followed him.

moments.title: David spares Saul
moments.text: At night David and Abishai went into Saul's camp and found him asleep with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. Abishai wanted to strike Saul, but David refused to harm the LORD's anointed.
